"""One API-only QA scratch-mount correction; same qualified images and receipts."""
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path('/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1')
INTENT='api-tmpfs-882-v1'
CONFIG_SHA='5fe24238cbf3a082c5de75a3bb888128d633a5e87bf0e81ad0a9b9e04a692d8c'
SERVING_SHA='1ff83bd587f234e5a1c68f30aca023e1dbf62610592914e0b0c797bf5ea55f66'
TMPFS='rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=128m'
def main():
    assert os.geteuid()==0 and os.uname().nodename=='anvil-qa-v1'
    os.umask(0o077)
    source=Path('/tmp/forge-release-88214ba/rollout-v2.py')
    assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='2e6807ecd3c0724ee8a7e68e5d2ed3d5f042c41258c88b39f1d932c3941f93b6'
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('reviewed_rollout',source);old=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(old)
    snapshot=Path('/tmp/forge-serving-acceptance-882.json').read_bytes()
    assert old.sha(snapshot)==SERVING_SHA
    baseline=json.loads(snapshot)
    config=ROOT/'config/compose-app.json';original=config.read_bytes()
    assert old.sha(original)==CONFIG_SHA
    before={name:old.inspect('anvil-qa-v1-'+name+'-1') for name in old.SERVICES}
    private_env=ROOT/'config/capture-runtime.env';private_env_sha=old.sha(private_env.read_bytes())
    for name,info in before.items():
        expected=baseline['services'][name]
        assert info['Id']==expected['id'] and info['Config']['Image']==expected['image'] and info['Image']==expected['image_id'] and info['State']['Running'] and info['RestartCount']==0
        assert old.comparable_host_config(info['HostConfig'])==old.comparable_host_config(baseline['profiles'][name]['HostConfig'])
        assert info['Mounts']==baseline['profiles'][name]['Mounts']
        environment=dict(item.split('=',1) for item in info['Config']['Env'])
        assert all(environment.get(flag)=='false' for flag in old.FLAGS)
    receipts={'component':ROOT/'runtime-functional/harbor-proof/component-qualification/current.json','capture':ROOT/'runtime-functional/capture-database-qualification/current.json'}
    def receipt_check(require_fresh=True):
        assert old.sha(private_env.read_bytes())==private_env_sha
        for key,path in receipts.items():
            raw=path.read_bytes();body=json.loads(raw)
            assert old.sha(raw)==baseline['receipts'][key]['sha256']
            if require_fresh:assert datetime.fromisoformat(body['expires_at'].replace('Z','+00:00'))>datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    def ledger():
        old.schema();old.quiescent()
        sql="SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND usename='anvil_app' AND xact_start IS NOT NULL AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()"
        command='exec psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -X -A -t -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1'
        result=subprocess.check_output(['docker','exec','-i','anvil-qa-v1-postgres-1','sh','-c',command],input=sql.encode(),timeout=15)
        assert result.strip()==b'0'
    receipt_check();ledger()
    candidate=copy.deepcopy(json.loads(original))
    assert not candidate['services']['api'].get('tmpfs') and not before['api']['HostConfig'].get('Tmpfs')
    candidate['services']['api']['tmpfs']=['/tmp:'+TMPFS]
    candidate['services']['api'].setdefault('labels',{})['io.adi.forge.runtime_intent']=INTENT
    backup=ROOT/'backups'/INTENT;backup.mkdir(mode=0o700);old.sync_directory(backup.parent)
    old.exclusive(backup/'compose-original.json',original)
    planned=backup/'compose-candidate.json';raw=json.dumps(candidate,sort_keys=True).encode();old.exclusive(planned,raw)
    old.exclusive(backup/'intent.json',json.dumps({'scope':'api_scratch_mount_only','images_unchanged':True,'before_ids':{k:v['Id'] for k,v in before.items()},'old_config_sha256':CONFIG_SHA,'candidate_config_sha256':old.sha(raw),'tmpfs':TMPFS,'receipts_reissued':False}).encode())
    unknown=False;activated=False;stopped=False;mutation_attempted=False;phase='preflight';terminal_mutations=set();diagnostic_failures=[]
    def note(path,value):
        try:old.exclusive(path,json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True).encode())
        except BaseException as error:diagnostic_failures.append({'phase':phase,'error_type':type(error).__name__})
    def run(phase,args,timeout=120,mutation=False,data=None):
        nonlocal unknown,mutation_attempted
        current_phase=phase
        set_phase(current_phase)
        if mutation:mutation_attempted=True
        try:result=subprocess.run(args,input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
        except BaseException as error:
            if mutation:unknown=True
            if isinstance(error,subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                for suffix,payload in (('stdout',error.stdout or b''),('stderr',error.stderr or b'')):
                    try:old.exclusive(backup/(phase+'.partial.private.'+suffix),payload)
                    except BaseException as retention:diagnostic_failures.append({'phase':phase,'error_type':type(retention).__name__})
            raise
        if mutation:terminal_mutations.add(phase)
        old.exclusive(backup/(phase+'.private.stdout'),result.stdout);old.exclusive(backup/(phase+'.private.stderr'),result.stderr)
        assert result.returncode==0,'Owned operation failed; retain private diagnostics'
        return result.stdout
    def set_phase(value):
        nonlocal phase
        phase=value
    def other_services():
        for name in old.SERVICES:
            if name=='api':continue
            info=old.inspect(before[name]['Id']);assert info['State']['Running'] and info['RestartCount']==0 and info['Config']==before[name]['Config'] and info['HostConfig']==before[name]['HostConfig'] and info['Mounts']==before[name]['Mounts']
    def health():
        end=time.monotonic()+120
        while True:
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen('https://anvil-qa.adi-labs.ai/api/v1/health',timeout=5) as response:
                    body=json.load(response)['data'];assert response.status==200 and body['api']=='ready' and body['database']=='ready' and body['live_inference']=='disabled' and body['harbor_live_dispatch']=='disabled'
                with urllib.request.urlopen('https://anvil-qa.adi-labs.ai/workspace',timeout=5) as response:assert response.status==200
                return body
            except Exception:
                if time.monotonic()>=end:raise
                time.sleep(1)
    def api_profile(info,with_tmpfs):
        assert info['Config']['Image']==before['api']['Config']['Image'] and info['Image']==before['api']['Image'] and info['Config']['User']==before['api']['Config']['User']
        assert info['State']['Running'] and info['RestartCount']==0
        for key in ('Cmd','Entrypoint','WorkingDir'):assert info['Config'][key]==before['api']['Config'][key]
        for key in ('Path','Args'):assert info[key]==before['api'][key]
        def env(value):
            rows=value['Config']['Env'];result=dict(row.split('=',1) for row in rows);assert len(result)==len(rows);return result
        assert env(info)==env(before['api'])
        expected=copy.deepcopy(before['api']['HostConfig'])
        if with_tmpfs:expected['Tmpfs']={'/tmp':TMPFS}
        assert old.comparable_host_config(info['HostConfig'])==old.comparable_host_config(expected)
        assert info['Mounts']==before['api']['Mounts']
        labels=info['Config']['Labels']
        for key in ('com.docker.compose.project','com.docker.compose.service','org.opencontainers.image.revision','io.adi.forge.release_intent'):assert labels[key]==before['api']['Config']['Labels'][key]
        if with_tmpfs:assert labels.get('io.adi.forge.runtime_intent')==INTENT
        else:assert labels.get('io.adi.forge.runtime_intent') is None
    compose=['docker','compose','-p','anvil-qa-v1','-f',str(config)]
    run('preflight',['docker','compose','-p','anvil-qa-v1','-f',str(planned),'config','--quiet'])
    try:
        receipt_check();ledger();other_services()
        run('stop-api',['docker','stop','--time','10',before['api']['Id']],mutation=True);stopped=True
        state=old.inspect(before['api']['Id'])['State'];assert not state['Running'] and not state['Restarting'] and state['Pid']==0
        old.exclusive(backup/'stopped-original.json',json.dumps({'id':before['api']['Id'],'state':state}).encode())
        ledger();receipt_check()
        temporary=config.with_name('compose-api-tmpfs-882-v1.json');old.exclusive(temporary,raw);old.replace_sync(temporary,config);activated=True
        run('up-api',compose+['up','-d','--no-deps','--force-recreate','--no-build','--pull','never','api'],mutation=True)
        phase='new-api-profile';info=old.inspect('anvil-qa-v1-api-1');assert info['Id']!=before['api']['Id'];api_profile(info,True);other_services()
        worker=Path('/tmp/forge-first-temp-worker-882.py').read_bytes()
        assert old.sha(worker)=='49ab2e1133a068a4fe2e95d282c052825481136f45635549e1e6c0f54e8981e8'
        result=json.loads(run('first-opa-proof',['docker','exec','-i',info['Id'],'/app/services/backend/.venv/bin/python','-I','-B','-'],data=worker,timeout=90))
        assert result['guard'] is None and result['differences']==[]
        readiness=Path('/tmp/forge-validate-both-882.py').read_bytes()
        assert old.sha(readiness)=='0f4a2f55beb6a35b0c61963a317e166175c64e70c20f8589f1ab2243e3e0337f'
        current=json.loads(run('api-readiness',['docker','exec','-i',info['Id'],'/app/services/backend/.venv/bin/python','-I','-B','-'],data=readiness,timeout=60))
        assert current['component_ready'] and current['capture']['ready'] and current['capture']['connection_probe_performed'] is False
        measurement="""import json,os,stat;from pathlib import Path
s=os.stat('/tmp');v=os.statvfs('/tmp');entries=[line.split() for line in Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines()];entry=next(row for row in entries if row[4]=='/tmp');split=entry.index('-');assert entry[split+1]=='tmpfs';assert {'rw','nosuid','nodev','noexec'}<=set(entry[5].split(','));assert stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)==0o1777
c=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup');memory={name:int((c/name).read_text()) for name in ('memory.current','memory.peak','memory.max','pids.current','pids.max')};assert memory['memory.max']==2147483648 and memory['memory.current']<memory['memory.max']-134217728
print(json.dumps({'tmpfs':True,'mode':oct(stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)),'uid':s.st_uid,'gid':s.st_gid,'capacity_bytes':v.f_frsize*v.f_blocks,'available_bytes':v.f_frsize*v.f_bavail,'inodes':v.f_files,'available_inodes':v.f_favail,'cgroup':memory},sort_keys=True))
"""
        resources=json.loads(run('tmpfs-resources',['docker','exec',info['Id'],'/app/services/backend/.venv/bin/python','-I','-B','-c',measurement],timeout=30))
        assert resources['capacity_bytes']==134217728 and resources['available_bytes']>100*1024*1024 and resources['available_inodes']>4096
        phase='health-final-readback';ready=health();receipt_check();ledger();other_services();api_profile(old.inspect(info['Id']),True)
        assert old.sha(config.read_bytes())==old.sha(raw)
        outcome={'status':'api_tmpfs_corrected_requires_ui_acceptance','api_id':info['Id'],'image':info['Config']['Image'],'profile':{'HostConfig':info['HostConfig'],'Mounts':info['Mounts']},'first_opa_proof':result,'api_readiness':current,'scratch_resources':resources,'health':ready,'config_sha256':old.sha(raw),'other_services_unchanged':True,'schema':133,'qualification_reissued':False,'paid_calls':False}
        old.exclusive(backup/'result.json',json.dumps(outcome,sort_keys=True).encode());print(json.dumps(outcome,sort_keys=True))
    except BaseException as error:
        failure={'error_type':type(error).__name__,'phase':phase,'mutation_unknown':unknown,'activated':activated,'stopped':stopped}
        note(backup/'failure.json',failure)
        if not mutation_attempted:
            print(json.dumps({'status':'precondition_refused_no_serving_mutation','failure':failure,'diagnostic_failures':diagnostic_failures}));raise SystemExit(1)
        if unknown:
            print(json.dumps({'status':'reconcile_unknown_mutation','failure':failure}));raise SystemExit(1)
        restored_config=False
        try:
            phase='rollback-config'
            assert old.sha(config.read_bytes()) in (CONFIG_SHA,old.sha(raw))
            temporary=config.with_name('compose-api-tmpfs-rollback-882-v1.json');old.exclusive(temporary,original);old.replace_sync(temporary,config)
            restored_config=old.sha(config.read_bytes())==CONFIG_SHA
        except BaseException as restore_error:
            note(backup/'config-restore-failure.json',{'error_type':type(restore_error).__name__})
        if not restored_config:
            print(json.dumps({'status':'config_restore_failed_no_further_mutation','failure':failure,'diagnostic_failures':diagnostic_failures}));raise SystemExit(1)
        try:
            phase='rollback-api-reconciliation'
            response=subprocess.run(['docker','inspect','anvil-qa-v1-api-1'],capture_output=True,timeout=15)
            # A missing canonical name does not prove renamed attempt-owned
            # containers are absent. Restore config, then HOLD for label/ID
            # reconciliation; never blindly recreate another API container.
            if response.returncode==1 and b'no such' in response.stderr.lower():
                note(backup/'missing-api-reconciliation-required.json',{'scope':'all_attempt_owned_api_names_and_ids','original_config_restored':True})
                raise RuntimeError('API family reconciliation required before recreate')
            assert response.returncode==0
            info=json.loads(response.stdout)[0]
            assert info['Name']=='/anvil-qa-v1-api-1' and info['Image']==before['api']['Image'] and info['Config']['Image']==before['api']['Config']['Image']
            labels=info['Config']['Labels'];assert labels.get('com.docker.compose.project')=='anvil-qa-v1' and labels.get('com.docker.compose.service')=='api'
            assert info['Id']==before['api']['Id'] or labels.get('io.adi.forge.runtime_intent')==INTENT
            if info['State']['Running']:run('rollback-stop',['docker','stop','--time','10',info['Id']],mutation=True)
            info=old.inspect(info['Id']);assert not info['State']['Running'] and not info['State']['Restarting'] and info['State']['Pid']==0
            assert restored_config
            ledger();receipt_check(False);other_services()
            run('rollback-up',compose+['up','-d','--no-deps','--force-recreate','--no-build','--pull','never','api'],mutation=True)
            restored=old.inspect('anvil-qa-v1-api-1');api_profile(restored,False);other_services();ready=health()
            assert old.sha(config.read_bytes())==CONFIG_SHA
            note(backup/'rollback.json',{'status':'original_profile_restored','api_id':restored['Id'],'config_sha256':CONFIG_SHA,'health':ready,'registration_accepted':False})
        except BaseException as rollback_error:
            note(backup/'rollback-failure.json',{'error_type':type(rollback_error).__name__,'phase':phase,'mutation_unknown':unknown})
        print(json.dumps({'status':'api_tmpfs_failed_retained','failure':failure,'diagnostic_failures':diagnostic_failures}));raise SystemExit(1)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
